title: File context on the first Read/Edit/Write of a file (claude-mem's PreToolUse timeline)
result: `atrium file-context <path>` returns the project's three newest episodes naming the file (word-index phrase; a generic name takes its directory), 0.2 s on the live index; the atrium-context mod adds them as tool-result context once per file per session.
evidence: `62849d6`; `tests/test_file_context.py`, mod tests; live run on `retrieve_context.py` and `register.js` returned the relevant 2026-10-09..14 episodes.
